text:
Brady Tkachuk comes back to Ottawa for the first time since leaving the Senators, after 572 games with them, and he arrives with Florida on a three-game winning streak after an 8-3 win over SEA, where Sam Bennett and Carter Verhaeghe each scored three. The Panthers are playing without Brad Marchand and Aleksander Barkov, and Lars Eller has stepped in beside Sam Reinhart and Tkachuk. Ottawa lost 3-1 at PHI, which snapped a nine-game winless run for the Flyers, and is missing Thomas Chabot and William Eklund. Tim Stützle's workload has climbed to 23:10 a night from 20:55 since Eklund went out.

FLA has been the better team at five on five, taking 56% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) in its games to OTT's 49%. Special teams offer a split: the Florida power play creates 1.29 expected goals a game against an Ottawa penalty kill that allows 0.75, while the Senators' power play (0.82) meets a Panthers kill that allows 0.91. Florida takes five penalties a game, which keeps handing out power plays.

The goalie matchup favors Ottawa. Projected starter Linus Ullmark is at +7.6 goals saved above expected (how many goals he has stopped beyond what an average goalie would on the same shots) this season, though he was at -13.3 last year. Akira Schmid, projected for Florida, is at -0.4 this season and -1.1 last year.

Watch Tkachuk, who carries a four-game point streak into his return and has a 60% chance of a point. Stützle has a 76% chance of a point and a 35% chance of a goal.
